runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed standard headers provide no PNG-specific image decoding interface.
FILE, fopen and fread are general stream I/O; they do not return PNG dimensions, chunks or pixels.

limit: Scoped to the ISO C standard library. System or platform image frameworks are separate third-party or runtime candidates and require their own control checks. No standard format-aware PNG API was documented to run.
